[NM Ant 0014](http://collections.smvk.se/carlotta-mhm/web/object/3100845)

Bell krater
Wide mouth with grooved, overhanging rim; tall, slender body; rolled-up handles at upper body; lower body tapering to a stem; tall base in two degrees. Red clay; black glaze; added white paint. Laurel branch encircling mouth; A: a satyr in panther’s skin holding a thyrsos and maenad with a white tambourine dancing to the left; to the right a seated satyr with a tambourine and an ecstatic maenad holding a thyrsos; in the background clusters of grape; a dotted disc as filling ornament; B: three conversing youths in himatia; in the background to the right a column; a quadrated disc as filling ornament; area beneath handles and at base of handle attachments reserved; below figures on both sides a meander

candidates.source_description:
[NM Ant 0008](http://collections.smvk.se/carlotta-mhm/web/object/3100844)
Wide, flaring mouth with overhanging, bevelled rim; groove at junction between mouth and body; deep body with almost straight upper wall and rounded, tapering lower wall; rectangular handles at upper body; grooved ring base. Yellowish red clay; black glaze; red wash (on underside). Two reserved bands on inside of mouth; laurel branch between bands encircling the outside; A: bearded Dionysos, wearing an ivy wreath, reclines on a bed with striped pillows; he holds a thyrsos in his left hand and a kantharos in his left; a maenad to the left, holding a thyrsos and wearing a loose chiton, is about to pour him some wine from an oinochoe; to the left a bearded satyr playing the double pipe; in the upper field a suspended wine-skin; below a pine-cone; B: three conversing youths in himatia, one of them holding a staff;
